summary: Boxlight filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its previously disclosed Series D convertible preferred financing and a new Series E preferred securities purchase agreement with J.J. Astor Co. The Series D purchasers consented to a certificate of amendment; the Series E covers 106,250 shares at $10 stated value, terms truncated in the excerpt. These are ordinary private-placement capital raises and charter amendments, not a special situation. Watch dilution, conversion reset mechanics, and Nasdaq minimum-price compliance risk.
